access_links.label: Newtok to Mertarvik on the U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit

description: Newtok to Mertarvik is a case study listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Native Village of Newtok; FEMA, Federal Emergency Management Agency; Alaska Department of Commerce, Community, and Economic Development, Division of Community and Regional Affairs. In 2015, the Alaska Native Village of Newtok was on the cusp of a safer, healthier future through decades of incremental strategic community planning with a close, coordinated team of federal and state agencies, legislators, and other diverse partners. By 2025, some of the plans designed to facilitate the move have worked out. Coverage: Alaska (2015). The toolkit gives Alaska as the location, 2015 as the year. The listed link gives the documented application. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the cited source documents and the outcomes reported were not checked, and no model or dataset used was verified. It can support comparison with similar adaptation projects and planning precedents. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
